entities.summary: Nana Gecaga, is a Kenyan businesswoman and corporate executive, who served as the CEO of the Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC), from 1 April 2016 to 29 December 2022. KICC is a building owned by the government of Kenya, which hosts conferences, concerts and exhibitions.
